data.desc: Capital Bancorp, Inc., Rockville, Maryland is a registered bank holding company incorporated under the laws of Maryland. Capital Bancorp has been providing financial services since 1999 and now operates bank branches in four locations in the Washington, D.C., and Baltimore, Maryland, metropolitan markets, one bank branch in Fort Lauderdale, Florida, one bank branch in Chicago, Illinois, and one bank branch in Raleigh, North Carolina. Capital Bancorp had assets of approximately $3.
